mobile/lib/main.dart: 1

`2-3`: ** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Heavy lift** **Import `longvita_core` through its barrel instead of internal subpaths.** Mobile (and Web) import many `package:longvita_core//.dart` paths directly. These include `models/`, `services/`, `firebase/` and `theme/`. `packages/core/lib/longvita_core.dart` already re-exports the whole public API. Direct subpath imports couple the clients to Core's internal file layout. A file move inside Core then breaks both clients. Import `package:longvita_core/longvita_core.dart` in client code. `packages/core/README.md` currently documents narrow imports as acceptable. Update it too. Then extend `scripts/check-monorepo.py` to reject `package:longvita_core/` imports under `mobile/` and `web/`. The new `core_assets_test.dart` files in both clients already use the barrel. ```diff -import 'package:longvita_core/services/i_report_metadata_repository.dart'; -import 'package:longvita_core/services/firestore_report_metadata_repository.dart'; +import 'package:longvita_core/longvita_core.dart'; ``` Based on learnings: "Flag code that imports directly from internal subpaths or nested modules of another package instead of the package's main entry." Also applies to: 9-13, 20-20, 22-22, 33-34
